tweak.PRIV-001.name: Turn off advertising ID
tweak.PRIV-001.desc: Apps can no longer use the advertising ID to personalize ads based on your app usage.
tweak.PRIV-001.side: Ads in apps are less personalized. The number of ads does not change.
tweak.PRIV-013.name: Turn off feedback requests
tweak.PRIV-013.desc: Windows no longer asks for feedback (same as setting the feedback frequency to 'Never').
tweak.PRIV-013.side: You no longer get feedback notifications. You can still send feedback through the Feedback Hub at any time.
tweak.PERF-016.name: Disable Fax service
tweak.PERF-016.desc: Sets the 'Fax' service to Disabled and stops it. Only present when the Windows Fax and Scan feature is installed.
tweak.PERF-016.side: Sending and receiving faxes with Windows Fax and Scan stops working. Scanning is not affected.
tweak.PERF-001.name: High performance power plan
tweak.PERF-001.desc: Activates the Windows 'High performance' power plan. A measurable gain in games is not proven.
tweak.PERF-001.side: Higher power draw and more heat. On laptops, battery life drops noticeably.
tweak.UI-001.name: Classic context menu (Windows 11)
tweak.UI-001.desc: Shows the full classic context menu on right-click instead of the shortened Windows 11 menu. Takes effect after restarting Explorer.
tweak.UI-001.side: The new compact Windows 11 context menu is no longer shown. A future Windows update may change this behavior.
tweak.PRIV-002.name: Minimum diagnostic data
tweak.PRIV-002.desc: Sets the diagnostic data policy to the lowest level. On Home and Pro this is the "Required" level; fully off is only possible in Enterprise and Education.
tweak.PRIV-002.side: Optional diagnostic data is no longer sent. Some Windows Insider features and personalized tips based on diagnostic data stop working. Windows shows "Some settings are managed by your organization".
tweak.PRIV-003.name: Disable telemetry service
tweak.PRIV-003.desc: Disables and stops the "Connected User Experiences and Telemetry" service (DiagTrack).
tweak.PRIV-003.side: Diagnostic Data Viewer and some problem reports stop working. Windows may re-enable the service after feature updates; the app shows this on the next start.
tweak.PRIV-005.name: Turn off activity history
tweak.PRIV-005.desc: Windows no longer collects or uploads activity history.
tweak.PRIV-005.side: History in Task View and resuming activities on other devices stop working. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-006.name: Deny location access for apps
tweak.PRIV-006.desc: Apps can no longer access the location. The setting is then locked in Windows.
tweak.PRIV-006.side: Maps, Weather, "Find my device" and other location-based features in apps work without location. Automatic time zone may become less accurate. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-008.name: Turn off web search in Start
tweak.PRIV-008.desc: Search in Start should no longer show web results. The effect is not documented by Microsoft.
tweak.PRIV-008.side: No Bing results and no search suggestions in Start and in the File Explorer search box. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-009.name: Turn off search highlights
tweak.PRIV-009.desc: Removes rotating content and hints from the search box and the search home page.
tweak.PRIV-009.side: No more daily topics, holidays or trends in search. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-010.name: Turn off Copilot in Windows
tweak.PRIV-010.desc: Turns off Copilot in Windows and hides its taskbar icon. Applies to Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 23H2; from 24H2 Copilot is a separate app.
tweak.PRIV-010.side: Copilot in Windows is no longer available. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-011.name: Prevent Recall snapshots
tweak.PRIV-011.desc: Prevents Recall from saving screen snapshots. Only relevant on Copilot+ PCs.
tweak.PRIV-011.side: Recall can no longer find anything. Existing snapshots are deleted by Windows and cannot be recovered. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-012.name: Turn off tailored experiences
tweak.PRIV-012.desc: Microsoft no longer uses your diagnostic data for personal tips, ads and recommendations.
tweak.PRIV-012.side: Tips and recommendations in Windows are less tailored to you. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-014.name: Turn off typing and inking data collection
tweak.PRIV-014.desc: Windows no longer learns from your typing and handwriting to build a personal dictionary.
tweak.PRIV-014.side: Word suggestions and handwriting recognition become less personal and may be less accurate.
tweak.PRIV-015.name: Hide language list from websites
tweak.PRIV-015.desc: Websites no longer receive your language list to show local content.
tweak.PRIV-015.side: Some websites may first show content in another language or region.
tweak.PRIV-016.name: Don't track app launches
tweak.PRIV-016.desc: Windows no longer records which apps you launch to tailor Start and search.
tweak.PRIV-016.side: "Most used" in Start stays empty and search results are no longer ranked by your usage.
tweak.PRIV-017.name: Turn off suggestions, tips and app promotions
tweak.PRIV-017.desc: Turns off suggestions in Start and Settings, tips, lock screen hints and silent installation of suggested apps.
tweak.PRIV-017.side: No more tips and suggestions from Windows. Hints about new features may be missing.
tweak.PRIV-018.name: Turn off recommendations in Start
tweak.PRIV-018.desc: Hides recommendations for tips, shortcuts and new apps in Start (Windows 11).
tweak.PRIV-018.side: The "Recommended" section no longer shows tips and app suggestions.
tweak.PRIV-019.name: Turn off account notifications in Start
tweak.PRIV-019.desc: Hides Microsoft account notices in Start (Windows 11).
tweak.PRIV-019.side: Notices such as "Back up your account" or "Set up OneDrive" no longer appear in Start.
tweak.PRIV-020.name: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
tweak.PRIV-020.desc: Windows no longer collects or sends problem reports when programs crash.
tweak.PRIV-020.side: Solutions in "Security and Maintenance" are no longer offered. Crash diagnostics for Microsoft and vendors are missing. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-021.name: Turn off Customer Experience Improvement Program
tweak.PRIV-021.desc: Opts all users out of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.
tweak.PRIV-021.side: No noticeable limitation. Application telemetry (PRIV-022) is turned off as well. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-022.name: Turn off app compatibility telemetry
tweak.PRIV-022.desc: Turns off application telemetry and the inventory collector, which send information about programs and devices to Microsoft.
tweak.PRIV-022.side: Windows detects program compatibility issues less reliably and may warn less often about incompatible programs. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-023.name: Turn off cross-device clipboard
tweak.PRIV-023.desc: Copied content is no longer uploaded to the cloud and shared with other devices.
tweak.PRIV-023.side: The local clipboard history (Windows + V) remains, but nothing is synced with other devices anymore. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PRIV-024.name: Delivery Optimization without peer-to-peer
tweak.PRIV-024.desc: Windows downloads updates and Store apps directly only and no longer shares them with other PCs.
tweak.PRIV-024.side: Your upload bandwidth is no longer used for others. With several PCs on the same network, updates may use somewhat more internet data. The related setting then shows "Managed by your organization" and can no longer be changed there.
tweak.PERF-002.name: “Ultimate Performance” power plan
tweak.PERF-002.desc: Creates a copy of the hidden Windows plan “Ultimate Performance” and activates it. It prevents short power-saving states of the processor and devices. A measurable gain in games is not proven.
tweak.PERF-002.side: Much higher power draw and more heat, even when idle. Not recommended on laptops and other battery devices: battery life drops sharply.
tweak.PERF-003.name: Visual effects: best performance
tweak.PERF-003.desc: Selects “Adjust for best performance” in Performance Options. Whether Windows applies all effects without the dialog is not proven; possibly only after signing in again.
tweak.PERF-003.side: Windows and menus look plainer (no shadows, no animations). Font smoothing stays on.
tweak.PERF-004.name: Turn off transparency effects
tweak.PERF-004.desc: Turns off transparency of the taskbar, Start menu and windows, like the switch in Settings under Personalization > Colors.
tweak.PERF-004.side: The taskbar and Start menu are no longer see-through. No other restriction.
tweak.PERF-005.name: Turn off window animations
tweak.PERF-005.desc: Turns off animations when minimizing and restoring windows and animations inside window contents. Takes effect immediately. There is no speed gain; windows just appear without a transition.
tweak.PERF-005.side: Windows open and close without a transition. Some people find that calmer, others abrupt.
tweak.PERF-006.name: Menu delay 100 ms
tweak.PERF-006.desc: Submenus appear after 100 instead of 400 milliseconds when the pointer rests on them. Purely a matter of comfort, no performance gain.
tweak.PERF-006.side: Submenus open faster, even when the pointer just passes over them.
tweak.PERF-007.name: Remove startup app delay
tweak.PERF-007.desc: Starts startup apps after sign-in without the usual short wait. Takes effect at the next sign-in. The effect is not documented.
tweak.PERF-007.side: Right after sign-in more programs start at once; the desktop can respond more slowly in the first seconds.
tweak.PERF-008.name: Block background apps
tweak.PERF-008.desc: Store apps may no longer run in the background when they are not open. Classic desktop programs are not affected.
tweak.PERF-008.side: Store apps such as Mail, Calendar, Weather or Phone Link do not update in the background and then show no notifications.
tweak.PERF-009.name: Turn off hibernation
tweak.PERF-009.desc: Turns off hibernation and deletes the hibernation file hiberfil.sys. This frees several gigabytes on the system drive (depending on memory).
tweak.PERF-009.side: Hibernate and Fast Startup are no longer available. Laptops with an almost empty battery shut down instead of hibernating; unsaved work can be lost.
tweak.PERF-010.name: Turn off Fast Startup
tweak.PERF-010.desc: Turns off Fast Startup. When shutting down, Windows then fully stops the kernel as well. Can help with dual boot and certain startup problems; this is not generally proven.
tweak.PERF-010.side: Starting from shutdown takes a little longer. Restarts are not affected.
tweak.PERF-011.name: Stop saving last access time
tweak.PERF-011.desc: NTFS no longer updates the last access time when files are read. Takes effect after a restart.
tweak.PERF-011.side: Programs that use the last access time (some backup programs, Storage Sense “not opened for …”) work less precisely.
tweak.PERF-012.name: Stop creating short 8.3 file names
tweak.PERF-012.desc: NTFS no longer creates short names in the old DOS format for new files. Existing short names remain. Takes effect after a restart.
tweak.PERF-012.side: Very old programs and some installers that expect short names can fail.
tweak.PERF-013.name: Windows Search set to manual
tweak.PERF-013.desc: The Windows Search indexing service no longer starts automatically. Background indexing stops.
tweak.PERF-013.side: Search in Start, File Explorer and Outlook becomes slower or no longer finds content inside files.
tweak.PERF-014.name: SysMain set to manual
tweak.PERF-014.desc: The SysMain service (formerly Superfetch), which preloads frequently used programs into memory, no longer starts automatically.
tweak.PERF-014.side: Frequently used programs may start a little slower, especially from hard disks (HDD).
tweak.PERF-015.name: Disable Print Spooler
tweak.PERF-015.desc: Disables the Print Spooler service. This reduces the attack surface; Microsoft recommends it as a protective measure on computers without a printer. Only useful if you never print.
tweak.PERF-015.side: Printing is no longer possible, not even “Microsoft Print to PDF”. Printers cannot be set up.
tweak.PERF-017.name: Disable Retail Demo service
tweak.PERF-017.desc: Disables the service for the in-store demo mode. It hardly ever runs in daily use anyway; the effect is correspondingly small.
tweak.PERF-017.side: The in-store demo mode can no longer be started.
tweak.PERF-018.name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
tweak.PERF-018.desc: Disables the service that manages and updates downloaded offline maps.
tweak.PERF-018.side: Offline maps in the Maps app are no longer downloaded or updated.
tweak.PERF-020.name: Processor time slices for foreground (expert)
tweak.PERF-020.desc: Sets processor time to short, variable time slices with strong preference for the active window (value 38 instead of 2). A benefit in games is not proven.
tweak.PERF-020.side: Programs in the background (downloads, recordings, streams) can become slower or stutter.
tweak.PERF-021.name: “Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser” task off
tweak.PERF-021.desc: Disables the scheduled task that regularly checks programs for compatibility with upcoming Windows versions and collects diagnostic data for it.
tweak.PERF-021.side: Windows may no longer warn about incompatible programs before a feature update.
tweak.PERF-022.name: “ProgramDataUpdater” task off
tweak.PERF-022.desc: Disables the scheduled task that collects data about installed programs for Microsoft.
tweak.PERF-022.side: No known restriction in daily use.
tweak.PERF-023.name: CEIP “Consolidator” task off
tweak.PERF-023.desc: Disables the scheduled task that consolidates and sends usage data for the Customer Experience Improvement Program.
tweak.PERF-023.side: No known restriction in daily use.
tweak.PERF-024.name: CEIP “UsbCeip” task off
tweak.PERF-024.desc: Disables the scheduled task that collects data about USB devices for the Customer Experience Improvement Program.
tweak.PERF-024.side: No known restriction in daily use.
tweak.PERF-025.name: Error report queue task off
tweak.PERF-025.desc: Disables the scheduled task that later sends collected error reports to Microsoft.
tweak.PERF-025.side: Queued error reports are no longer sent; Microsoft can then offer solutions for crashes less often.
tweak.PERF-026.name: Disable startup entry
tweak.PERF-026.desc: Turns off the approval of a startup entry, like Task Manager. The entry and the program stay unchanged.
tweak.PERF-026.side: The program no longer starts automatically after sign-in; you can still open it manually.
tweak.GAME-001.name: Game Mode on
tweak.GAME-001.desc: Turns on Windows Game Mode. It is on by default; this only helps if it was turned off. A measurable gain is not proven.
tweak.GAME-001.side: During a game, Windows updates and background tasks can be delayed.
tweak.GAME-002.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling on
tweak.GAME-002.desc: Lets the graphics card schedule its own memory. Some driver features (for example frame generation) require it. A general gain is not proven. Takes effect after a restart.
tweak.GAME-002.side: With some drivers or older games stutter or errors can occur; reset it then.
tweak.GAME-003.name: Do not open Game Bar with controller
tweak.GAME-003.desc: Xbox Game Bar no longer opens with the Xbox button of a controller, and the startup panel at game start goes away. Win+G still opens it.
tweak.GAME-003.side: The controller's Xbox button no longer opens Game Bar.
tweak.GAME-004.name: Game recording and broadcasting off
tweak.GAME-004.desc: Turns off Windows game recording and broadcasting (Game DVR) by policy.
tweak.GAME-004.side: Recordings and screenshots through Game Bar are no longer possible. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.GAME-005.name: Background recording off
tweak.GAME-005.desc: Windows no longer records the last minutes of a game in the background.
tweak.GAME-005.side: "Record what happened" is no longer available.
tweak.GAME-006.name: Fullscreen optimizations off globally
tweak.GAME-006.desc: Turns off Windows fullscreen optimizations for all games. The effect depends on the game and can also be worse; better test per game in a game profile.
tweak.GAME-006.side: Fast Alt+Tab switching and overlays can change. Some games run worse afterwards.
tweak.GAME-009.name: Optimizations for windowed games
tweak.GAME-009.desc: Turns on the Windows optimization for games in windowed and borderless mode (Windows 11 22H2 and later). A gain is not measured.
tweak.GAME-009.side: Rarely display errors in older games; reset it then.
tweak.GAME-010.name: Variable refresh rate in windowed mode
tweak.GAME-010.desc: Allows variable refresh rate for games in windowed mode too, if monitor and graphics card support it.
tweak.GAME-010.side: Brightness can flicker in some games; reset it then.
tweak.GAME-011.name: Mouse acceleration off
tweak.GAME-011.desc: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision": the pointer moves in proportion to the hand movement, regardless of speed. No effect on frame rate.
tweak.GAME-011.side: At high screen resolution the mouse may need to be moved further; the pointer speed can compensate.
tweak.GAME-012.name: Sticky Keys shortcut off
tweak.GAME-012.desc: Pressing Shift five times no longer opens the Sticky Keys prompt, for example in the middle of a game. Sticky Keys itself stays unchanged.
tweak.GAME-012.side: Anyone who turns on Sticky Keys with the shortcut now has to use Settings.
tweak.GAME-013.name: Filter Keys and Toggle Keys shortcuts off
tweak.GAME-013.desc: Holding the right Shift key (Filter Keys) or Num Lock (Toggle Keys) no longer opens a prompt. The features themselves stay unchanged.
tweak.GAME-013.side: Anyone who turns on these accessibility features with the shortcuts now has to use Settings.
tweak.GAME-019.name: Turn off memory integrity (expert)
tweak.GAME-019.desc: Turns off memory integrity (HVCI, core isolation). Microsoft names it as a possible cause of lower game performance; a gain on this computer is not measured. Takes effect after a restart.
tweak.GAME-019.side: Weaker protection against malware that attacks drivers or the kernel. Some anti-cheat systems require memory integrity; games may then refuse to start or connect. If it is locked by UEFI, it stays on anyway.
tweak.GAME-021.name: Global timer resolution (expert)
tweak.GAME-021.desc: Makes a fine timer resolution requested by a program apply to the whole system again, as in older Windows versions. A benefit is not proven. Takes effect after a restart.
tweak.GAME-021.side: Higher power draw, shorter battery life on laptops.
tweak.GAME-007.name: Fullscreen optimizations off for one game
tweak.GAME-007.desc: Turns off fullscreen optimizations only for this game (like Properties > Compatibility). Other compatibility options of the file stay.
tweak.GAME-007.side: The effect depends on the game; Alt+Tab and overlays can change.
tweak.GAME-008.name: GPU preference for one game
tweak.GAME-008.desc: Sets which graphics card Windows prefers for this game (like Settings > Display > Graphics). Only matters with more than one graphics card.
tweak.GAME-008.side: On laptops, "High performance" lowers battery life while the game runs.
tweak.GAME-016.name: Permanently high priority for one game (expert)
tweak.GAME-016.desc: Windows always starts this program with high processor priority. No measured benefit. Blocked for games with anti-cheat.
tweak.GAME-016.side: Other programs get less processor time while the game runs. Antivirus programs may flag the entry.
tweak.UI-002.name: Left-aligned taskbar
tweak.UI-002.desc: The Start button and taskbar icons sit on the left instead of the center, as in Windows 10.
tweak.UI-003.name: Hide Task View button
tweak.UI-003.desc: Hides the Task View button on the taskbar. Win+Tab keeps working.
tweak.UI-003.side: Task View is only reachable with Win+Tab or a swipe gesture.
tweak.UI-004.name: Hide Chat icon
tweak.UI-004.desc: Hides the Chat icon (Teams) on the taskbar. Only Windows 11 up to 23H2; newer versions no longer have the icon.
tweak.UI-004.side: Quick access to Teams chat from the taskbar goes away.
tweak.UI-005.name: Hide Widgets icon
tweak.UI-005.desc: Hides the Widgets icon on the taskbar. On Windows 11 24H2 and later Windows blocks this change; use DEB-027 there.
tweak.UI-005.side: Widgets are only reachable with Win+W.
tweak.UI-006.name: Search as icon
tweak.UI-006.desc: Shows search on the taskbar only as an icon instead of a search box. Saves space.
tweak.UI-006.side: Search opens by clicking the icon or pressing the Windows key and typing.
tweak.UI-007.name: Show file extensions
tweak.UI-007.desc: File Explorer shows extensions such as .exe or .pdf. This helps to spot disguised malware (for example invoice.pdf.exe).
tweak.UI-007.side: When renaming you can accidentally change the extension.
tweak.UI-008.name: Show hidden files
tweak.UI-008.desc: File Explorer shows hidden files and folders (for example AppData). Protected system files stay hidden.
tweak.UI-008.side: More entries in folders; accidentally deleting settings files becomes easier.
tweak.UI-009.name: File Explorer opens to "This PC"
tweak.UI-009.desc: File Explorer opens with the drive overview instead of Home.
tweak.UI-009.side: Recently used files are no longer visible right away.
tweak.UI-010.name: More pinned apps in Start
tweak.UI-010.desc: The Start menu shows more pinned apps and fewer recommendations (Windows 11 22H2 and later).
tweak.UI-011.name: Seconds in the clock
tweak.UI-011.side: Slightly higher power draw because the clock is redrawn every second.
tweak.DEB-027.name: Turn off widgets
tweak.DEB-027.desc: Turns off the Windows 11 widgets feature by policy (news, weather, stocks in the widgets board).
tweak.DEB-027.side: Widgets can no longer be opened, not even with Win+W. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.NET-001.name: DNS: Cloudflare
tweak.NET-001.desc: Switches the DNS servers of all physical network adapters to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) (IPv4 and IPv6). According to its privacy policy Cloudflare does not store IP addresses permanently.
tweak.NET-001.side: Networks with their own name resolution (company network, router names such as fritz.box, some parental filters) may no longer work. VPN adapters stay unchanged; VPN programs that manage DNS themselves can overwrite the setting.
tweak.NET-002.name: DNS: Google
tweak.NET-002.desc: Switches the DNS servers of all physical network adapters to Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8) (IPv4 and IPv6). According to its privacy policy Google stores query data temporarily.
tweak.NET-002.side: Networks with their own name resolution (company network, router names such as fritz.box, some parental filters) may no longer work. VPN adapters stay unchanged; VPN programs that manage DNS themselves can overwrite the setting.
tweak.NET-003.name: DNS: Quad9
tweak.NET-003.desc: Switches the DNS servers of all physical network adapters to Quad9 (9.9.9.9) (IPv4 and IPv6). Quad9 blocks known malware domains.
tweak.NET-003.side: Networks with their own name resolution (company network, router names such as fritz.box, some parental filters) may no longer work. VPN adapters stay unchanged; VPN programs that manage DNS themselves can overwrite the setting.
tweak.NET-009.name: Turn off LLMNR
tweak.NET-009.desc: Turns off multicast name resolution (LLMNR). This protects against a known attack in foreign networks in which credentials are captured.
tweak.NET-009.side: Devices on the local network without a DNS entry may no longer be reachable by name. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.NET-010.name: TCP auto-tuning to default
tweak.NET-010.desc: Resets the automatic tuning of the TCP receive window to the Windows default "normal" in case another program changed it. Not a booster.
tweak.NET-010.side: No restriction; this is the default state of Windows.
tweak.NET-011.name: Network card power saving off
tweak.NET-011.desc: Windows may no longer turn off the network card to save power. Can help with connection drops after waking up; this is not generally proven.
tweak.NET-011.side: Slightly higher power draw, shorter battery life on laptops.
tweak.DISK-001.name: Enable TRIM
tweak.DISK-001.desc: Windows reports deleted areas to the SSD (TRIM) so that it stays fast and durable. On by default.
tweak.DISK-004.name: Storage Sense on
tweak.DISK-004.desc: Windows automatically deletes temporary files and empties the Recycle Bin when needed according to the Storage Sense rules.
tweak.DISK-004.side: Files in the Recycle Bin and in "Downloads" can be deleted automatically after the configured periods; the periods are in Settings.
tweak.DISK-007.name: Turn off reserved storage
tweak.DISK-007.desc: Frees the storage that Windows holds back for updates and temporary files (usually a few gigabytes).
tweak.DISK-007.side: Updates can fail when storage is low. Without administrator rights Ascended Tweaks shows the state as "not available".
tweak.NET-004.name: Custom DNS servers
tweak.NET-004.desc: Switches the DNS servers of all physical network adapters to the entered addresses.
tweak.NET-004.side: Wrong addresses make websites unreachable; resetting restores the previous state.
tweak.UPD-001.name: Pause updates
tweak.UPD-001.desc: Pauses feature and quality updates for the chosen number of days, like the pause in Windows Settings. At most 35 days; after that, Windows resumes updates by itself.
tweak.UPD-001.side: No security updates arrive during the pause. When it ends, Windows checks for updates right away; a new pause is only possible after that.
tweak.UPD-002.name: Defer feature updates by 90 days
tweak.UPD-002.desc: New Windows versions (feature updates) are offered 90 days after release. Security updates keep arriving as usual.
tweak.UPD-002.side: New features arrive later. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.UPD-003.name: Defer quality updates by 7 days
tweak.UPD-003.desc: Monthly updates are installed 7 days after release. Problems in an update are often found before it reaches you.
tweak.UPD-003.side: Security updates also arrive 7 days later; known vulnerabilities stay open during that time. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.UPD-004.name: No drivers through Windows Update
tweak.UPD-004.desc: Windows Update no longer installs driver updates. Useful if you install graphics or other drivers from the manufacturer yourself.
tweak.UPD-004.side: You have to keep drivers up to date yourself. Drivers that are part of a security update still arrive. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.UPD-005.name: No automatic restart while signed in
tweak.UPD-005.desc: Windows does not restart by itself after updates while someone is signed in. Updates are still downloaded and scheduled automatically.
tweak.UPD-005.side: According to Microsoft, restarts after updates may not happen at all if you never sign out; security updates only take effect after a restart. Restart regularly. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.UPD-006.name: Active hours 8 AM to 10 PM
tweak.UPD-006.desc: Sets active hours to 8 AM to 10 PM. During this time, Windows does not restart automatically after updates.
tweak.UPD-006.side: Active hours can no longer be changed in Settings. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.UPD-007.name: Stay on this Windows version
tweak.UPD-007.desc: Keeps Windows on the current version: feature updates to a newer version are not offered. Security updates for this version keep arriving.
tweak.UPD-007.side: After this version reaches end of support, there are no more security updates. Reset the setting by then at the latest. The setting shows "Managed by your organization".
tweak.DEB-027.impact: One background process less; memory effect not measured.
tweak.DEB-027.plain.title: Turn off widgets
tweak.DEB-027.plain.desc: The widgets board with news and weather goes away.
tweak.DISK-001.impact: Only matters if TRIM was turned off; Windows default is on.
tweak.DISK-001.plain.title: Keep SSD fast
tweak.DISK-001.plain.desc: Tells the SSD which space is free so it stays fast.
tweak.DISK-004.impact: Registry value undocumented; effect needs a visual check.
tweak.DISK-004.plain.title: Free space automatically
tweak.DISK-004.plain.desc: Windows deletes old temp files and the Recycle Bin by itself.
tweak.DISK-007.impact: About 7 GB gain not measured; updates may fail when space is low.
tweak.DISK-007.plain.title: Free reserved storage
tweak.DISK-007.plain.desc: Frees space Windows keeps back for updates.
tweak.GAME-001.impact: On by default; no proven gain.
tweak.GAME-001.plain.title: Turn on Game Mode
tweak.GAME-001.plain.desc: Windows gives the running game priority.

tweak.BROW-001.name: Edge startup boost off
tweak.BROW-001.desc: Edge no longer pre-starts in the background when you sign in to Windows (policy "Startup boost" off). This saves memory and one startup program.
tweak.BROW-001.side: Edge shows "Managed by your organization" because this is a policy. Opening Edge for the first time takes a little longer.
tweak.BROW-001.impact: Fewer Edge processes after sign-in; small gain at startup.
tweak.BROW-001.plain.title: Do not preload Edge
tweak.BROW-001.plain.desc: Edge no longer runs quietly from Windows startup.
tweak.BROW-002.name: Edge background mode off
tweak.BROW-002.desc: Edge no longer keeps running after you close the last window (policy "Continue running background apps" off).
tweak.BROW-002.side: Edge shows "Managed by your organization". Notifications from web apps only arrive while Edge is open.
tweak.BROW-002.impact: Only helps if background mode was on; then frees memory.
tweak.BROW-002.plain.title: Close Edge fully
tweak.BROW-002.plain.desc: Edge no longer uses memory after you close it.
tweak.BROW-003.name: Chrome background mode off
tweak.BROW-003.desc: Chrome no longer keeps running in the background after you close it (policy "BackgroundModeEnabled" off). Only works if Chrome is installed.
tweak.BROW-003.side: Chrome shows "Managed by your organization". Extensions and apps running in the background stop with the last window.
tweak.BROW-003.impact: Frees memory if Chrome would otherwise keep running in the background.
tweak.BROW-003.plain.title: Close Chrome fully
tweak.BROW-003.plain.desc: Chrome no longer uses memory after you close it.
tweak.POWR-001.name: USB power saving off
tweak.POWR-001.desc: Windows no longer turns off idle USB devices in the active power plan when plugged in (USB selective suspend). Only on PCs without a battery.
tweak.POWR-001.side: Higher idle power draw. Locked on laptops.
tweak.POWR-001.impact: Benefit for mouse and keyboard not proven.
tweak.POWR-001.plain.title: USB devices always on
tweak.POWR-001.plain.desc: Windows no longer puts idle USB devices to sleep.
tweak.POWR-002.name: PCI Express power saving off
tweak.POWR-002.desc: Link state power management (ASPM) for PCI Express is turned off in the active power plan when plugged in. Only on PCs without a battery.
tweak.POWR-002.side: Higher idle power draw and heat. Locked on laptops.
tweak.POWR-002.plain.title: PCI Express always on
tweak.POWR-002.plain.desc: Graphics card and SSD links no longer save power.
tweak.POWR-003.name: Minimum processor state 100%
tweak.POWR-003.desc: The minimum processor state in the active power plan is set to 100 percent when plugged in. The processor clocks down less at idle. Only on PCs without a battery.
tweak.POWR-003.side: Clearly higher idle power draw and heat, fans may get louder. Locked on laptops.
tweak.POWR-003.impact: Faster response to sudden load; usually no difference within a game.
tweak.POWR-003.plain.title: Processor always ready
tweak.POWR-003.plain.desc: The processor stays at full power, even when idle.
tweak.POWR-004.name: Never turn off hard disk
tweak.POWR-004.desc: In the active power plan, "Turn off hard disk after" is set to "Never" when plugged in. Mainly affects classic hard disks (HDD). Only on PCs without a battery.
tweak.POWR-004.side: Slightly higher power draw; the disk keeps spinning. Locked on laptops.
tweak.POWR-004.impact: No more waiting for a stopped hard disk to spin up.
tweak.POWR-004.plain.title: Hard disk always ready
tweak.POWR-004.plain.desc: No waiting when a hard disk has to spin up again.
tweak.DEFN-001.name: Gentler Defender scans
tweak.DEFN-001.desc: Microsoft Defender uses at most 20 instead of 50 percent of the CPU on average during scans. Protection stays fully on; only the scan load changes.
tweak.DEFN-001.side: Scans take longer. The limit does not apply to idle scans (Windows default).
tweak.DEFN-001.impact: Fewer stutters when a scan starts while you play.
tweak.DEFN-001.plain.title: Virus scans slow you less
tweak.DEFN-001.plain.desc: Defender stays on, but scans use less CPU.
tweak.NET-012.name: Energy-efficient Ethernet off
tweak.NET-012.desc: Turns off "Energy-efficient Ethernet" (IEEE 802.3az) on network adapters whose driver offers this property.
tweak.NET-012.side: Slightly higher power draw. The connection drops briefly while switching.
tweak.NET-012.impact: Small benefit: the link no longer enters its power saving state.
tweak.NET-012.plain.title: LAN without power pauses
tweak.NET-012.plain.desc: The network link no longer pauses to save power.
tweak.GAME-022.name: Highest refresh rate
tweak.GAME-022.desc: Sets the main display to the highest refresh rate it offers at the current resolution, for example 144 Hz instead of 60 Hz. Games and the desktop move more smoothly.
tweak.GAME-022.side: The screen goes dark for a moment while switching. On notebooks a higher rate uses more battery. If the picture stays black, it comes back after resetting in the app or by choosing the old rate in Settings > Display.
tweak.GAME-022.impact: Clearly smoother motion when the display was running below its maximum.
tweak.GAME-022.plain.title: Use full screen speed
tweak.GAME-022.plain.desc: Your screen shows as many pictures per second as it can.
tweak.GAME-023.name: Pointer speed to default (1:1)
tweak.GAME-023.desc: Sets the pointer speed back to the middle of the slider (10, the Windows default). Together with mouse acceleration off, the pointer then moves exactly as far as the mouse reports. Games that read the mouse directly do not change.
tweak.GAME-023.side: If you chose a different pointer speed on purpose, the pointer now feels faster or slower on the desktop. Your mouse software or DPI setting can make up for it.
tweak.GAME-023.impact: Changes something only if the pointer speed was moved away from the middle.
tweak.GAME-023.plain.title: Mouse speed back to 1:1
tweak.GAME-023.plain.desc: The pointer moves exactly as far as your mouse.
tweak.GAME-024.name: Faster key repeat
tweak.GAME-024.desc: Shortest delay before a held key starts repeating and the fastest repeat rate (the two sliders in Control Panel > Keyboard). Affects held keys in Windows, chats and menus, not games that read the keys directly.
tweak.GAME-024.side: While typing, a held key repeats sooner; this can produce double letters at first.
tweak.GAME-024.impact: Small: only held keys outside games that read keys directly.
tweak.GAME-024.plain.title: Faster key repeat
tweak.GAME-024.plain.desc: Held keys repeat sooner and faster.
